block_groups.vintage: ACS 2019–2023 estimates joined by DWR to 2020 block-group geography
block_groups.classification: DAC23 supplied by DWR: Y, N, Data not available; no classification recomputed
block_groups.limitations: No ACS margins of error in this extract. Income designation does not measure canal dependence, water quality, dry wells, individual household income, or project effects.

places.source: 2020 Census Gazetteer, retained national place file
places.selection: Reference point within the regional envelope
places.limitations: Includes cities and CDPs, not all settlements; points are not footprints or water-service areas.
places.block_group_join: Gazetteer reference point containment in original unsimplified DWR polygons, excluding holes. The selected point inherits block-group context, never a whole-town estimate or service assignment.

repair.method: Clip older reference centerline to geocoded Avenue 136 / Road 208 and Avenue 64 / Road 192 latitudes. Crossing responses retained. Broad corridor locator only; no eastward offset or new as-built line fabricated.
